content: AT-SPI: no established standalone Go bindings; org.a11y.Bus runs on target (verified). AT-SPI2 IS standard D-Bus with full introspection XML (unlike IBus), so godbus Object.Go/ExportObjectPath or generated proxies work; interfaces org.a11y.atspi.Accessible/Application/Text/Editable/Component; getText(0,-1) reads editor content. Pragmatic harness: python3-gi 3.48.2 + gir1.2-ibus-1.0 + gir1.2-atspi-2.0 installed on Ubuntu 24.04 (verified); spec 7.3 already prescribes at-spi via python3-gi. Go alternative: small godbus client or m31labs.dev/fluffyui atspi package (UI-automation module, heavier).
